description:
Actor and comedian Suhaimi Yusof and his youngest son Sufi spend rare one-on-one time together, discussing fame, family and the impact of a life-changing stroke. The pair grapples with expectations, vulnerability and the transition into adulthood. Through heartfelt adventures, honest confessions and long-overdue conversations, each pair discovers new perspectives on one another and strengthens the bonds that matter most.
